companyInfo.name: SteamCore Energy Engineering LLP
companyInfo.vision: To be the most trusted engineering partner for process industries, enabling them to achieve the highest standards of energy efficiency and operational reliability.
companyInfo.mission: Providing practical, result-oriented solutions in boiler systems, utilities, and energy management to improve efficiency, reliability, and compliance.

founder.name: Ajit D Jawale
founder.experience: More than 24 years of experience in utilities and energy systems across chemical, paper, and sugar industries.
qualifications: Board Member, BOE & Attendant Exams (Govt. of Maharashtra)

services.name: Boiler & Utility Consultancy
services.description: Performance evaluation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and efficiency improvement for industrial plants.

services.name: Energy Audit & Optimization
services.description: Detailed BEE-aligned audits, waste heat recovery, fuel optimization, and practical recommendations to reduce fuel and power costs.

services.name: Reliability & Maintenance
services.description: Preventive strategy, SOP development, mechanical integrity support, RCM approach, RCA, and structured reliability improvement.

services.name: Project Engineering
services.description: Boiler and utility project execution support, equipment selection, commissioning, and performance testing.

services.name: Training Programs
services.description: Specialized training for plant operators and engineers on boiler operations, safety, and energy conservation.
